pochette.alt: Pochette de Summer Hits Vol.2 par Various Artists

texte.corps:
Summer is here, and it’s time for round two of our digital series with a new VA. Following the spirit of our first edition, this compilation brings together 8 artists we love: familiar faces and new discoveries.

From House to Minimal, Deep, Acid, and Breaks, 8 sun-drenched tracks made for long sunny days, warm nights, and everything in between.

pochette.alt: Pochette de Interdimensional Groove EP par Merov'

texte.corps:
The 5th Groove to Grave release is here. Step into our spaceship and head toward Merov’ Galaxy, a universe where the funk, groove, and electro planets collide. This EP invites you to explore a musical cosmos of irresistible rhythms and richly detailed sound design, perfect for electro-funk lovers.

Each track is built around sharp Rhodes and Clavinet keys, laying down cosmic, groove-heavy foundations. At the heart of the tracks, deep textures and bleepy FX create a hypnotic space, while the synths deliver airy, futuristic leads, giving every cut an interstellar dimension.

pochette.alt: Pochette de Summer Hits Vol.1 par Various Artists

texte.corps:
Introducing our very first VA : a compilation of 8 tracks by artists we love and who orbit around the label. Alongside our vinyl releases, this digital series, designed as an annual rendezvous, gives us the chance to invite our friends to share a track, just for the love of sound.

House, Minimal, Deep, Funk or Downtempo: 8 sun-soaked tracks to set the tone for your summer, your beach days, your befores, your parties, your afters.

pochette.alt: Pochette de Homo Musicus EP par Emi Ömar

texte.corps:
Emi Ömar kicks off the year on our imprint series with a powerful and evocative EP, designed as a sonic journey through his live performances of 2024.

Leading figure in electro-funk, Emi Ömar delves into uncharted music territories. Known for his sharp prestations, his blend of vocoder, bleepy/funky sounds, and deep/fat grooves captures the raw energy of live electronic music.

The tracks weave a musical narrative that reflects the vision and technical mastery of a passionate artist. An experience that will resonate with both electronic music enthusiasts and explorers of new soundscapes.

pochette.alt: Pochette de Cerberus EP par Kitchen Plug

texte.corps:
Groove To Grave Records is back with a second vinyl release, and for this one they are welcoming the Parisian trio Kitchen Plug.

From ghetto house to break and minimal these 3 silly boys love to produce tracks with nasty bass, metallic acid and raw drums. For their first solo EP on vinyl, they wanted to add a early 2000’ electro vibe to their ghetto style for a brainless result. Get ready for 4 bangers, including a tremendous remix from Karaba.

pochette.alt: Pochette de Spacy Taste EP par Azbine

texte.corps:
This is the first vinyl release of the parisian label: Groove To Grave.

For this EP they are welcoming the group Azbine from Lyon in France. Azbine was created by 2 childhood friends in 2018. They take their influences from house and minimal through deeptech and they want to bring a retro has-been touch in their electronic universe. This is their first solo EP.

newsletter.corps: Merci. Rien n'est encore enregistré : la newsletter attend que le label choisisse son outil. En attendant, suis le label sur Bandcamp.

pourquoi.corps: Trois diggers, des vinyles en pressage limité, souvent sans repress, et une compilation chaque été pour inviter les copains. On ne fait pas de la house pour les playlists, on en fait pour les disquaires et les pistes de danse.

presentation.corps: Ce jeune et fougueux label de diggers parisiens vogue en quête d'artistes émergents, propageant joie de vivre et musique au travers de leurs sorties vinyles. Le collectif assume pleinement ses influences groovy avec des riffs puissants, des synthés stellaires et des basslines grasses. Tantôt Breakbeat, parfois Minimal, la House persiste et signe toutefois comme fer-de-lance du crew G2G.
